wave: fix/win32-esm-absolute-path-import (a third defect, found while answering the user's follow-up)
userReport: ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME: Only URLs with a scheme in: file, data, and node are supported by the default ESM loader. On Windows, absolute paths must be valid file:// URLs. Received protocol 'c:'
whyNotMine: My two commits touch only: packages/{mpd-config,mpd-roles}-plugin/src+dist, packages/mpd-dsh-adapter-plugin/src (type-only), four dsh-tui test files + one new test helper, scripts/mpd-tui-panels.ts, READMEs and evidence/**. None of them adds or changes a dynamic import.

The failing files were last changed by unrelated commits: `git log -2 -- packages/mpd-mcp-lsp packages/mpd-mcp-gitbash packages/mpd-mcp-astgrep packages/mpd-mcp-codegraph packages/mpd-better-sidebar-host` -> 44db0a0c `feat(mcp): restore the language-server bootstrap for ~40 languages`, c09e6f28 `feat(mcp): replace the last vendored MCP servers with declared npm dependencies`.
The defect is a Windows-vs-POSIX loader rule in a pre-existing production launcher; it reproduces against the PRISTINE tree (proved by `git stash`).

rootCause.site: packages/mpd-mcp-lsp/src/launch.ts (dist launch.js:1395) — `await import(entry)`; the twin at packages/mpd-mcp-gitbash/src/launch.ts (dist launch.js:436) is identical.
rootCause.why: `resolveDependencyEntry` (packages/mpd-mcp-shared/dependency-entry.ts:155-156) answers an ABSOLUTE FILE PATH (`resolve(packageDir, manifest.bin)`). Node's ESM loader requires a `file://` URL on Windows: it parses the drive letter as a URL scheme and throws before a single MCP byte is exchanged. The two sibling launchers never hit this because their specifiers are RELATIVE (`mpd-mcp-astgrep`'s `./cli.js`, `mpd-mcp-codegraph`'s `./serve.js`), which resolve against the module URL.
rootCause.impact: The LSP MCP server (cclsp) was UNAVAILABLE on Windows; the host restarted the crashing child in a loop. Measured in .mpd/logs/mpd-mcp-lsp.log: six `[mpd-mcp-lsp] starting cclsp@0.7.0 from C:\...` lines inside 35 s.

reproductionBefore.observed: exit code 1; stderr carried the user's exact stack: `Error [ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME]: ... Received protocol 'c:'  at throwIfUnsupportedURLScheme (node:internal/modules/esm/load:193:11)`; the last log line was `starting cclsp@0.7.0 from C:\MyDoc\DshProj\My-Power-Dsh\node_modules\.bun\cclsp@0.7.0+5b6b5129650ecc67\node_modules\cclsp\dist\index.js`

fix: packages/mpd-mcp-lsp/src/launch.ts: `await import(pathToFileURL(entry).href)` (`pathToFileURL` was already imported in this file).
packages/mpd-mcp-gitbash/src/launch.ts: same, plus the `import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url"` it was missing.
Both dists rebuilt with the pinned toolchain (bun 1.4.0) from the repo root.

reproductionAfter.observed: STILL ALIVE after 8 s (a stdio MCP server waiting for input = healthy); stderr EMPTY; the log shows real work: `Preloading LSP server: node.exe .../typescript-language-server@4.4.1/.../cli.mjs --stdio`, then `Successfully preloaded LSP server for extensions: ts, tsx, js, jsx, mjs, cjs, mts, cts` / `LSP server preloading completed`.
